course_name_original: The Industrial Electric Power Equipment Maintenance (SB10653)
course_name_en: The Industrial Electric Power Equipment Maintenance

learning_outcomes.text: The students to learn how to organize and carry out the activities of the industry electric power equipment maintenance.
The students be able to decide practical issues.

syllabus_topics: The organization of the industry electric power equipment maintenance.
The industrial heat and furnace electric power equipment maintenance.
The maintenance of the electric apparatus for the protection and control processes of the electric power equipment.
The electric power machines and transformers maintenance.

assessment_methods.method: written exam (two topics from study material)

assessment_rules: The exam includes a written part on two topics from the study material, which is followed by oral discussion and forming of the final mark.
